node.title: Pencil forcing outside the residual band, and distinct-pencil fibre sharing
node.statement: For a gate-clean zero-escape block system B(V,t,t_0,k) with V>=5 and dim Ann>=1, if t>=2e-2 then the blocks cannot be covered by two distinct pencils each carrying at least three blocks. Independently, two distinct pencil-structured live families share at most one fibre. The complementary band t<=2e-3, equivalently h>=3d+3, is not proved and includes the prize shapes; no full T0 or occupancy conclusion is asserted there.
